Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing ultranarrow vehicles to operate two abreast.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to ultranarrow vehicles; and adding a new sectionto chapter 46.61 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.61 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) For purposes of this section, "ultranarrow vehicle" refers toany vehicle having a maximum width of fortytwo inches from mirror tomirror. (2) Notwithstanding RCW 46.61.140, ultranarrow vehicles may operateup to two abreast in a single lane.
